topPRs.author: standujar
topPRs.body:
# Relates to

Relates to #24407. Depends on Draft #29651.

This is the durable schema foundation only. It does not close #24407, activate the backup scheduler, retire the legacy cron, or claim the 10,000-due-agent fairness acceptance.

- [x] This PR is intentionally stacked on `fix/22965-billing-cancel-deletion-authority` rather than targeting `develop` directly; its exact base is merge-forwarded onto current `origin/develop` with zero conflicts.
- [ ] `bun install` and the full `bun run verify` were not rerun; exact affected suites and structural checks are recorded below.
- [x] A reviewer can confirm the database behavior from deterministic PGlite and isolated real-PostgreSQL evidence below.

# Sync with develop

- [x] Exact base #29651 at `9fadd5187cc94e4590f86d554889ea71df2da16b` is merge-forwarded onto `origin/develop@44b4e2ffcea333184c7521343dc5807fc8f043da`; this branch merges that base with zero conflicts.
- [ ] Full-repository `bun run verify` was not run; exact affected validation is green and hosted CI remains required.

# Risks

Medium. This adds 18 PostgreSQL migrations and a narrowly marked nontransactional migration mode for online concurrent indexes. A defect could rewrite existing data, block hot writers, admit forged work, or publish the wrong index identity. The implementation keeps each schema migration below 100 lines, validates exact PostgreSQL-canonical index definitions and OIDs, fails closed on incomplete remnants without live-table repair DDL, and publishes markers plus the migration ledger only after final table/index locks and post-lock identity/ownership checks.

# Background

## What does this PR do?

This PR adds the durable authority required before a fair backup scheduler can enroll or claim work:

- write-once sandbox and node source identity plus snapshot visibility fencing;
- frozen enrollment cohorts, monotonic claim turns, priority passes, and shard authorities;
- tenant-bound admission work with explicit queued/deferred/leased/settled states, replay identity, lease fencing, and guarded deletion;
- durable queued-to-leased admission proofs bound to the exact transaction, cycle, shard, pass, attempt, high-water mark, and live lease before a claim cycle can restart;
- bounded claim/deferred/expired-lease indexes and exact hot-catalogue lane-conflict indexes;
- an explicit one-statement `CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY` migration path with canonical definition checks, fail-closed crash remnants, same-name race rejection, final publication locks, and atomic marker/ledger publication;
- Drizzle schema parity and full account-deletion FK classification;
- metadata-only GC admission reuse without rewriting existing GC rows.

There is intentionally no production repository, producer, caller, or `agent_backup_admission_work` insertion in this slice. The next enrollment PR is the first producer and must settle all admission work before irreversible account deletion. The following claim PR owns the 10,000-due-agent drain/fairness and zero-oversubscription proof.

## What kind of change is this?

Feature foundation and database integrity improvement.

# Documentation changes needed?

No user-facing documentation changes in this schema-only slice. Runtime activation and operator documentation belong to the later caller/deployment slice.

# Testing

## Where should a reviewer start?

1. `packages/cloud/shared/src/db/schemas/agent-backup-admission.ts`
2. migrations `0346_agent_backup_admission_sandbox_source_stamp.sql` through `0363_agent_backup_admission_claim_guard.sql`
3. `packages/cloud/scripts/admin/migrate-with-diagnostics.ts`
4. `migrate-with-diagnostics.concurrent-index-mode.test.ts` and its PostgreSQL integration
5. `agent-backup-admission-cohort.test.ts`
6. the source-stamp and GC PostgreSQL integrations
7. `account-deletion-foreign-key-policy.ts`

## Detailed testing steps

Exact candidate: `c508b772a936806e2da6532005d30e72dc697635`

Exact stacked base: `9fadd5187cc94e4590f86d554889ea71df2da16b`

Validated `origin/develop`: `44b4e2ffcea333184c7521343dc5807fc8f043da`

Bun 1.3.14:

- Migrator deterministic suite: 46 passed, 19 intentional RealPG skips, 223 assertions across 7 files.
- Concurrent-index focused unit suite: 14/14 tests, 77 assertions, including crash replay, incomplete-remnant fail-close, same-name races, atomic marker/ledger rollback, and attachment during publication.
- Admission cohort PGlite suite: 7/7 tests, 108 assertions, including heartbeat/forgery rejection and exact fresh queued-to-leased restart proof.
- Account-deletion FK policy suite: 6/6 tests, 14 assertions.
- PostgreSQL 16 source-stamp suite: 1/1 test, 9 assertions over 10,000 historical sources.
- PostgreSQL 16 GC handoff suite: 1/1 test, 5 assertions over 10,000 GC intents.
- PostgreSQL 16 concurrent-index suite: 1/1 test, 41 assertions. It proves writer availability during the hot 10,000-row build, exact OID/definition publication, same-name and post-validation swap rejection, crash replay, fail-closed invalid remnants, atomic marker/ledger rollback, and a real `ALTER INDEX ... ATTACH PARTITION` publication race with `attached=true`, `marker=NULL`, and zero ledger rows.
- `bun run --cwd packages/cloud/shared typecheck`: passed.
- `bun run --cwd packages/cloud/api typecheck`: passed, including Worker dry-run.
- `bun run --cwd packages/cloud/shared db:check-migrations`: passed.
- Canonical migration validator: 347 consecutive entries; schema slice `0346`–`0363` is exactly journal indices 329–346.
- All 18 admission SQL migrations remain below 100 lines.
- Biome on all 11 changed TypeScript files: passed.
- `actionlint -config-file .github/actionlint.yaml .github/workflows/cloud-tests.yml`: passed.
- `git diff --check 9fadd5187cc...c508b772a93`: passed.

topPRs.title: feat(cloud): claim backup work without shard starvation
topPRs.author: standujar
topPRs.body:
# Relates to

Relates to #24407 and epic #20726. Depends on Draft #29694.

This Draft adds the bounded claimant/recovery authority only. It does not activate a production caller, reserve catalogue entries, invoke a provider, mutate capacity, trigger autoscale, deploy, or retire the legacy scheduler.

- [x] This PR is intentionally stacked on `feat/24407-backup-admission-enrollment-repository-v4`.
- [x] The exact stacked base and current `origin/develop` were revalidated with zero conflicts.
- [x] Exact-head affected tests and `bun run verify:cloud` passed.

# Risks

Medium. Claiming coordinates concurrent workers across 64 shards and strict tenant/node lanes. A defect could duplicate leases, starve a shard, cross an expired fence, or violate priority ordering. Durable frozen recovery cursors, trigger guards, post-lock database time, exact generation/attempt fences, and bounded `SKIP LOCKED` scans constrain those risks.

# What does this PR do?

- Claims queued `schedule_capture / reserve_capture` work with strict business-priority passes.
- Uses maximum-cardinality tenant/node lane matching without deriving authority from opaque work UUIDs.
- Adds durable, monotone recovery high-water/cursor state for deferred and expired work.
- Advances recovery and shard service turns even when raw rows are locked, preserving cross-shard fairness.
- Fences heartbeat, defer, and settlement against the exact live generation, attempt, cycle, and post-lock database clock.
- Adds real PostgreSQL and PGlite coverage, including 10,000 due rows plus 640 arrivals across all 64 shards.
- Performs database-only admission changes; capacity/autoscale/provider sentinels remain unchanged.

topPRs.title: fix(cloud): gate remaining app and MCP provider calls
topPRs.author: lalalune
topPRs.body:
## Summary

- enforce one combined account-standing decision before remaining paid or generative provider dispatches
- preserve safe cached denial reasons and detailed structured error context
- mark dispatch durably immediately before provider work, then settle exact or unknown usage asynchronously without a cache readback
- cover app review/promotion/assets/SEO, automation generators, Firecrawl, provisioning chat, hosted search, voice verification, inbound vision, realtime voice, unified RPC, and Hugging Face egress quota
- remove redundant room-title and secondary fact-extraction LLM calls; fail closed for the dormant unadmitted connection-enforcement model path
- replace Hugging Face KV read-modify-write accounting with atomic Redis reservations
- repair exact-head CI blockers in UI keyboard-shortcut mocking and the Windows watchdog identity probe

Refs #29967.

## Ordering invariant

Every covered path follows validate -> one standing snapshot -> durable admission -> dispatch marker -> provider -> deferred settlement. Malformed, unauthorized, unavailable, or bad-standing requests dispatch nothing. After dispatch, provider uncertainty settles conservatively; status/cache updates run through `waitUntil` and do not read the cache back.

The trusted inbound-vision webhook has no credential key, so its standing check is one synchronous combined SQL decision in the existing claim/quota transaction rather than a credential-keyed KV read. Its completion/failure settlement is one fenced asynchronous UPDATE with no SELECT or RETURNING.

## Verification

Exact head: `6df6de8397ecfa084620c851ce27739a8a50ff9b`

- `bun run verify`: 375/375 workspace tasks passed; all subsequent repository audits passed
- focused Cloud admission/provider suites passed across automation, Firecrawl, provisioning/search, voice verification, inbound vision, realtime/RPC/HF, and connection enforcement
- shared and Cloud API typechecks passed
- production Worker bundle dry-run passed
- UI chat-sheet E2E: 72 screenshots, zero page errors; formerly failing send/dictation/multisend paths passed
- Windows watchdog unit suite: 51 tests / 132 expectations passed; POSIX real self-test passed
- direct Cerebras baseline: 20/20 success, first-token p50 132.77 ms / p95 252.21 ms, total p50 148.77 ms / p95 256.44 ms

Hosted exact-head checks and staging deployment/latency certification remain the merge and production-promotion gates.

topPRs.title: feat(cloud): enroll backup work by durable shard
topPRs.author: standujar
topPRs.body:
# Relates to

Relates to #24407. Depends on Draft #29662.

This is the repository-only enrollment producer. It does not activate a caller, claim/defer/settle work, invoke a provider, trigger autoscale, retire the legacy scheduler, or claim the 10,000-due-agent fairness acceptance.

- [x] This PR is intentionally stacked on `feat/24407-backup-admission-schema-v3` because it writes the authority introduced by #29662.
- [x] Exact base #29662 is merge-forwarded through current `origin/develop` with zero conflicts.
- [ ] Full-repository `bun run verify` was not rerun; exact affected validation is recorded below.

# Risks

Medium. Enrollment advances sandbox schedule state and creates durable backup work. A defect could skip due work, duplicate queue entries, cross a source occurrence, or strand a shard. The repository therefore uses one atomic transaction, frozen per-shard cohort authority, bounded disjoint candidate frontiers, exact source revalidation, deterministic organization locking, and replay-safe insertion.

# What does this PR do?

- Leases one of 64 durable enrollment shards with `FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED`, preferring incomplete cohorts.
- Freezes the database cutoff, snapshot xid, RPO, cohort identity, and keyset cursor for resumable enrollment.
- Selects three disjoint due frontiers, each bounded at `limit + 1`, then globally orders and caps the result.
- Revalidates active organization lifecycle and exact sandbox/node occurrence authority before mutation.
- Atomically advances `next_backup_at`, enrollment cursors, queued `schedule_capture` / `reserve_capture` work, and shard progress.
- Inserts exact replay identities with `ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING`; queued rows begin with attempts `0`, no lease, and no claim proof.
- Performs database admission mutations only. It has no provider, provisioning, capacity, autoscale, or restore dependency.

# Testing

Exact candidate: `087b75a5bd0e66f70070bd5c0c0cbc8158dc289d`

Exact stacked base: `3c7b7a2cc9060bc37ded8fc67b71b3d33d71d23a`

Validated `origin/develop`: `6e8882b47c3f4f242d2a3c655d287f2969d00595`

Bun 1.3.14:

- PGlite enrollment suite: 8/8 tests, 50 assertions. Covers bounded owner input, frozen RPO/keyset resume, two-call shard separation, source rotation, post-snapshot deferral, replay idempotence, and account lifecycle fencing.
- PostgreSQL 16 lock evidence: 1/1 test, 7 assertions. A foreign session holds shard 0; the test proves exact `55P03` before and after the repository call, bounded progress on shard 1, then shard 0 enrollment after release. It asserts two exact queued rows, attempts `0`, all lease/claim-proof fields `NULL`, and zero restore leases.
- `bun run --cwd packages/cloud/shared typecheck`: passed.
- `bun run --cwd packages/cloud/api typecheck`: passed, including Worker dry-run.
- `bun run --cwd packages/cloud/shared db:check-migrations`: passed.
- Biome on all three changed TypeScript files: passed.
- `actionlint -config-file .github/actionlint.yaml .github/workflows/cloud-tests.yml`: passed.
- `git diff --check d89cab179aa...fc05705431e`: passed.
- Fresh independent exact-base/head review: CLEAN, no P0, P1, or P2 findings.

# Evidence Gate

<!-- evidence-row:before-screenshots -->
- [ ] N/A - no rendered UI surface changes.
<!-- evidence-row:after-screenshots -->

- [ ] N/A - no frontend path changed.
<!-- evidence-row:llm-trajectory -->
- [ ] N/A - no LLM, prompt, provider, action, or model path changed.
<!-- evidence-row:domain-artifacts -->

<!-- evidence-row:ocr-review -->

# Known gaps / failures

- There is no production importer or caller at this SHA. The existing runtime still uses the legacy scheduler path.
- There is no queue claimant, explicit deferred transition, reservation bridge, settlement worker, or capture activation in this PR.
- The PostgreSQL proof covers two contended shards, not 10,000 due agents, 64-shard starvation freedom, capture throughput, or RPO capacity.
- The 10,000-row planner and distinct-identity race are proven; the separate 10,000-due-agent drain and starvation gate remains open.
